sentences.text: This study used a single case report design to compare two imaging methods in one 57-year-old female patient with a small 5-mm lesion.
The nerve structure was seen more clearly with red dichromatic imaging than with white-light imaging at every stage of the surgery, which removed the lesion in one piece without damaging the nerve.
The authors conclude that red dichromatic imaging could be a helpful tool for keeping the nerve safe during this specific surgery.
